status: Owner decisions recorded; implementation and end-to-end verification incomplete; production billing gates are closed; not live subscription terms

cancellation.access: Retain already-paid access until the period ends

refund.requiredWorkflow: Private owner billing-review queue and explicit decisions; do not silently drop refund events

bankDispute.whileOpen: Pause new paid audits and stop renewal
bankDispute.ifWon: Restore any remaining paid time; do not automatically re-enable renewal
bankDispute.ifLost: Do not restore the disputed paid time automatically

savedReports: Retained; no report deletion from cancellation, refund or dispute

productionGates.decision: Closed on 2026-11-20 because material approvals remain open: tax and jurisdiction, paid-feature readiness, and live end-to-end billing. No live subscription has completed a billing cycle, and checkout does not currently calculate tax despite the active Texas registration.
productionGates.coverageNote: These flags gate the GEO plan checkout and the service, content, competitor, and monthly-service paths that consult them. Studio, Directory Listing Kit, and Entity Authority checkout endpoints do not consult LIVE_PAYMENTS_ENABLED, so closing it does not by itself stop those live purchases.
productionGates.note: Set in the Netlify production environment on 2026-11-20. A production deploy is required for the values to take effect.
